semantics: compressed-tensors NVFP4: dequantized weight = fp4_code * block_scale_e4m3 / weight_global_scale (the loader passes 1/global as the kernel multiplier). Fused w13 kernels (Marlin and B12X) accept ONE global scale per expert; stock vLLM keeps column 0 (gate) and only warns.
stock_loader_effect: The up half of 8,291 fused experts is dequantized with the gate divisor; effective up weights are wrong by up to 9.96x. This is the correctness defect behind the as-published W4A4 degeneration, not a speed tuning issue.
kraken_beta_status: The karmic-kraken-beta compressed-tensors NVFP4 MoE loader and B12X experts still take a single per-expert w13 global scale (_normalize_expert_scale keeps column 0). The beta does NOT fix independent gate/up scales; it would load Orca with the same defect on the fast path.

larger_divisor.reason: Rescaling the smaller-divisor half upward overflows E4M3 (source block scales already reach 448; scaled values reached 4460.09), saturating and destroying those blocks.

smaller_divisor.note: FP4 payloads are untouched; per-element weight error equals the relative error of its block scale. Exact preservation is impossible in E4M3 for non-power-of-two ratios, so this is a bounded, measurable approximation, not an identity.

exact_reference: The qualified Marlin W4A16 per-projection path (glm53-orca-qualification campaign/runtime-repair) preserves both divisors exactly and remains the correctness reference for any fast-path comparison.
decision: Fast-path Orca serving must use an explicit, logged smaller-divisor reconciliation plus a measured fidelity delta against the exact reference. It must never be presented as bit-identical to the checkpoint, and the default policy remains refuse-on-mismatch.
